        sections: [

        prompt: "Read the interview notes and give me the three things we should pay attention to next.",
        attachments: ["Interview notes", "Research questions", "Customer feedback"],
        acknowledgment: "I\u2019ll compare the interviews and look for the themes that come up more than once.",

        title: "What we heard this week",
        summary: "The recurring themes from eight interviews, with a small next step for each.",
        sections: [
            ["Finding the latest version", "People lose time checking which document is current. Try one shared home for project decisions before adding more notifications."],
            ["Handing work over", "Handoffs often miss the reason behind a decision. Add a short context field to the next handoff pilot."],
            ["Seeing what changed", "Teams want a quick account of what moved since yesterday. Test a daily roundup with the smallest useful set of changes."],
        ],
    },
    memberC: {
        name: "Morgan", role: "Project coordinator", idle: "Keeping everyone in the loop",
        greeting: "I can help the team stay caught up. Give me the updates, and I\u2019ll make sure the next steps are clear.",
        prompt: "Make a Friday handoff from this week\u2019s updates. Show what shipped, what\u2019s blocked, and who owns the next step.",
        attachments: ["Weekly updates", "Project tracker", "Team check-ins"],
        acknowledgment: "I\u2019ll check the updates for an owner, a blocker, and a clear next step.",
        steps: ["Reviewing this week\u2019s updates", "Checking owners and dependencies", "Preparing the team handoff"],
        finished: "The handoff is ready. Every open item has an owner and a next step.",
        title: "Friday, all caught up",
        summary: "A short handoff so Monday can start with the work instead of another status meeting.",
        sections: [
            ["Shipped", "The first AI teammates are available to the pilot group. The revised invite flow and keyboard navigation are included."],
            ["Blocked", "The import flow is waiting on a sample export. Robin will follow up with the pilot team on Monday morning."],
            ["Up next", "Riley owns the onboarding notes. Casey will collect pilot feedback. Review the first week together on Thursday."],
        ],
    },
} as const;
